entry.title: State the data guarantee precisely
entry.content:
State the data guarantee precisely

The profile said no repository here contains "a line of dialogue". Corrected
to "a transcript", alongside the claims that are exactly true and carry the
same weight: no subtitle file, no transcript, no dialogue translation, no
example sentence, no timing data. See grab-series-vocab for how the gap was
found.

entry.title: Profile README for the TV Series Vocab matrix
entry.content:
Profile README for the TV Series Vocab matrix

The GitHub profile README, and the top level of the matrix: one tool
repository, three corpus repositories, and a short account of why the project
exists at all.

The number it is built around: 33,270 collected cards, 35.9% of them
duplicates. `pick up` was collected independently 39 times. Duplicate cards
are not just wasted effort — they multiply the review load and leave the
interval scheduler optimising against the wrong data. The fix is not a better
prompt, it is a different data structure.

Points at all four repositories, states plainly that no repository here
contains subtitle text, and lists the gaps rather than hiding them: Friends
stops at season 5, 10,926 entries are missing a headword, glosses are Chinese
only, difficulty labels are unset.

README in English and Simplified Chinese.
